question: How does the self wrap itself in many dharma and adharma states?
premises: The self wraps itself in many states.
Those states are made of dharma and adharma.
inference: Self-wrapping spans from avicya to shiva-end without doubt.
plain_english: He wraps himself, without doubt, in many states made of dharma and adharma, from avicya to the end of shiva.
